description: This file defines the DateIPC class, which implements the ObjectIPC interface to facilitate the serialization and deserialization of Date objects to and from JSON format within an IPC framework.

classes.name: DateIPC
classes.description: A class that wraps a Date object and provides JSON serialization/deserialization methods consistent with the ObjectIPC interface.

methods.name: DateIPC
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a DateIPC object, optionally with a Date value.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the Date object into a JSON object, representing the date as a timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: fromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object to restore the Date value from a timestamp.
